result.title: CanopyKV: Remember beyond the Crop for Fast Active Visual Reasoning
result.summary: Active visual reasoning enables multimodal models to answer challenging visual questions by gathering fine-grained evidence through iterative image inspection and tool use. However, accumulating crops and reasoning tokens expands the key-value (KV) cache, making compression important for reducing memory and inference costs. Existing KV compression methods typically select historical tokens based on attention, recency, or redundancy. These criteria do not explicitly distinguish locally replaced evidence from complementary information needed for future exploration: each crop refreshes a local region, while earlier views may still support subsequent decisions. Discarding such evidence can impair accuracy or require additional search, while scoring and cache reorganization can offset the computational savings from compression. We introduce CanopyKV, a training-free KV compression framework that uses parent-child crop relationships to retain complementary evidence, keeps retained history stable, and protects the state needed for ongoing reasoning. Tool metadata provides retention signals without additional attention scoring, while compact KV storage reduces subsequent attention costs. Across VisualProbe, V*, HR-Bench, and MME-Lite, CanopyKV achieves state-of-the-art answer accuracy and end-to-end efficiency among the evaluated KV compression methods. On MME-Lite, it retains approximately one-quarter of Dense's total KV while improving accuracy by 10.5 percentage points and accelerating complete reasoning by $1.64\times$.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文研究主动视觉推理中多轮裁剪与推理 token 导致 KV 缓存膨胀的问题，提出免训练的压缩框架 CanopyKV：利用父子裁剪关系与工具元数据判断哪些历史证据需要保留，稳定保留历史并保护持续推理所需状态，从而在不额外做注意力打分的前提下压缩缓存。
AI.relevance_reason: 直接涉及视觉证据在内部状态中的保留与丢弃、以及「继续查看 vs. 停止」的成本权衡，可作为考察 KV 缓存结构与视觉旁路信息坍缩的实验参照；其准确率与端到端效率结论仍需阅读原文核验。
